# `json_array_length`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the number of elements in the outermost JSON array.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
json_array_length(jsonArray)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `json_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- json_array_length, example 1
> SELECT json_array_length('[1,2,3,4]');
4
```

```sql
-- json_array_length, example 2
> SELECT json_array_length('[1,2,3,{"f1":1,"f2":[5,6]},4]');
5
```

```sql
-- json_array_length, example 3
> SELECT json_array_length('[1,2');
NULL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.1.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
